name: TwIL-8B

lineage.how_derived: full-parameter SFT then GRPO/DAPO reinforcement learning; two variants, balanced (default) and verbose

purpose: 8.8B reasoning model for math, code and instruction following (card).

The base granite-4.2-8b is Apache-2.0 per its card tag (not re-read).

variants.notes: also verbose Q4_K_M 5.35, Q8_0 9.35, F16 17.59 GB; main repo holds safetensors (72.8 GB total with GGUFs)

pc-12gb.notes: 5.35 GB file fits the VRAM budget (9.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-16gb.notes: 5.35 GB file fits the VRAM budget (13.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-24gb.notes: 5.35 GB file fits the VRAM budget (21.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-32gb.notes: 5.35 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 5.35 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 5.35 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 5.35 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Granite architecture; official GGUFs in the repo.

strengths: vendor reports MATH-500 and LiveCodeBench above Gemma 4 31B at 8.8B
weaknesses: trails on knowledge-heavy benchmarks (GPQA Diamond, MMLU-Pro, HLE) by the vendor's own statement
competitor scores are published figures, not re-run

tona_fit.reason: Vendor numbers (MATH-500 98.2, LiveCodeBench 81.6 on the verbose variant) are strong for 8.8B but self-reported, and the card admits it trails on knowledge benchmarks. Reasoning/coding-focused Granite RL fine-tune at 5.35 GB Q4_K_M; needs our own coding eval.

open_questions: independent reproduction of the LiveCodeBench and MATH-500 numbers
